title: Adidas x Bad Bunny Ballerina 'Flamboyan' Exclusive Drop at All The Right NYC — Two Weeks Before Wide Release
detail: The Bad Bunny x Adidas Ballerina 'Flamboyan' (style code KI7916, Vivid Red/Cloud White-Power Red, $120) launched today, May 15, 2026, at All The Right boutique in New York City — the exclusive early in-store drop two weeks ahead of the scheduled May 30 wide release on Adidas Confirmed and select retailers. The sneaker features a tonal vivid red canvas upper with suede overlays, a satin collar, white Three Stripes leather branding, a gum sole, maroon lace toggle, gold 'Benito' embossing on the upper, an 'Adidas Para Bad Bunny' midsole stamp, and a zig-zag-stitched tongue tag. The silhouette is based on an 1980s Taekwondo sneaker last and marks the first new Ballerina colorway in over a year following three initial launches in March–April 2025. Named after Puerto Rico's flamboyán tree — whose fiery red-orange canopy blankets the island each spring and is a deep symbol of the island's natural beauty and cultural identity — the name is spelled in Puerto Rican vernacular rather than standard Spanish 'flamboyán,' consistent with *Debí Tirar Más Fotos*' recurring emphasis on local cultural specificity and island pride. The Flamboyan continues Bad Bunny's Adidas silhouette series — launched in 2019 with the Forum Low — and arrives alongside three new F50 Ghost Sprint World Cup colorways, expanding his Adidas football range ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026 co-hosted in the United States, Canada, and Mexico.
